propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has six years and three months of project management experience in financial services, confirmed against employer references.
propositions.rationale: The resume gives the dated project manager roles and the HR verification note states the employer-checked total.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds a current PRINCE2 Practitioner certification, renewed in September 2024 and checked on PeopleCert's verification service.
propositions.rationale: The resume lists the certification and its renewal and the recruiter verification records the issuer check.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the pricing-practices remediation project with a maintained plan and RAID log and reported monthly to the change steering committee.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the project and the reporting, and the work sample shows the RAID log with the committee's decisions.

expectedGap: Coordinating user acceptance testing across business areas is not documented; the sources show test sign-off collected from one team.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the employer-confirmed total of six years and three months, the verified PRINCE2 certificate and the documented remediation project; do not count the coordinator period as project management or extend the test sign-off into running acceptance testing.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how acceptance testing was organised on the remediation project, which business areas took part and what the candidate personally coordinated.
